name: activation-alignment
js: const t=editorTest; t.load(); const rows=t.alignment(); if(rows.some(r=>!r.opened||r.shift!==0))throw Error(JSON.stringify(rows)); return rows

name: typing-500kb
js: const t=editorTest; const size=t.load(); const typing=t.benchmark(); if(typing.accepted!==200||typing.restyles!==0||typing.median>=16)throw Error(JSON.stringify(typing)); return {size,typing,exact:t.check()}

name: structural-restyle-caret
js: const t=editorTest; t.load(); const typing=t.benchmark(true); if(typing.accepted!==200||typing.restyles!==200)throw Error(JSON.stringify(typing)); const caret=t.caret();if(!caret||caret.anchor!==caret.focus)throw Error('Caret lost');return {typing,exact:t.check(),caret}

name: composition-browser-mutation
js: const t=editorTest; t.load(); t.editor.open(t.controller.blocks[0].key,0); const el=document.querySelector('[data-role=block-editor]'); t.select(4); const g=t.controller.doc.generation, n=t.editor.restyles; el.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionstart',{bubbles:true})); document.execCommand('insertText',false,'*'); if(t.controller.doc.generation!==g||t.editor.restyles!==n)throw Error('Composition changed application state'); const held=!!t.controller.doc.heldRange(Date.now()+10000); el.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionend',{bubbles:true})); if(t.controller.doc.generation!==g+1||!held)throw Error('Composition did not commit'); return {applicationRestylesDuringComposition:0,held,exact:t.check()}

js:
const t=editorTest; t.load('one

two'); t.editor.open(t.controller.blocks[0].key,3); const before=t.controller.doc.source, el=document.querySelector('[data-role=block-editor]'); el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('beforeinput',{inputType:'insertParagraph',bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); if(t.controller.doc.source!=='one


two')throw Error(JSON.stringify(t.controller.doc.source)); t.check(); let intercepted=0; document.querySelector('#document').addEventListener('beforeinput',e=>{if(e.inputType==='historyUndo'&&e.defaultPrevented)intercepted++}); document.execCommand('insertText',false,'x'); document.execCommand('undo'); if(t.controller.doc.source!=='one

name: cross-block-delete
hold-agent-scroll
js: const t=editorTest;t.load(); const b=t.controller.blocks[35];t.editor.open(b.key,3);document.execCommand('insertText',false,'x');await t.settle();const el=document.querySelector('[data-role=block-editor]');el.scrollIntoView();scrollBy(0,100);const node=el.firstChild,html=el.innerHTML,selection=getSelection().toString(),top=el.getBoundingClientRect().top;const held=t.controller.doc.heldRange();const generation=t.controller.doc.generation;t.host.emit('agentApply',{operationId:'held',baseGeneration:generation,edits:[{start:held.start,end:held.start+1,text:'!',expected:t.controller.doc.source.slice(held.start,held.start+1)}]});if(t.controller.doc.generation!==generation)throw Error('Agent changed held range');const head=t.controller.blocks[0],old=t.controller.doc.source.slice(head.start,head.end);t.host.emit('agentApply',{operationId:'above',baseGeneration:generation,edits:[{start:head.start,end:head.end,text:old+'\r\n'+('taller line\r\n').repeat(8),expected:old}]});await t.settle();const drift=el.getBoundingClientRect().top-top;const unchanged=el.firstChild===node&&el.innerHTML===html&&getSelection().toString()===selection;if(Math.abs(drift)>.5||!unchanged)throw Error(JSON.stringify({drift,unchanged}));return {heldRefused:true,anchorDrift:drift,activeDOMUnchanged:unchanged,exact:t.check()}

name: format-find-and-lock
cross-block-input-events
js:
const t=editorTest,results=[];for(const kind of ['type','delete','cut','paste']){t.load('one

two

three');const els=document.querySelectorAll('[data-block]'),a=reader.sourceModel.point(els[0],1),b=reader.sourceModel.point(els[2],2);getSelection().setBaseAndExtent(a.node,a.offset,b.node,b.offset);const selected=t.editor.selection(),before=t.controller.doc.source,g=t.controller.doc.generation;let event,value='';if(kind==='type'){value='Z';event=new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Z',bubbles:true,cancelable:true});}else if(kind==='delete'){event=new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Delete',bubbles:true,cancelable:true});}else{const data=new DataTransfer();if(kind==='paste'){data.setData('text/plain','P
Q');value='P
Q';}event=new ClipboardEvent(kind,{clipboardData:data,bubbles:true,cancelable:true});}els[0].dispatchEvent(event);if(!event.defaultPrevented||t.controller.doc.generation!==g+1||t.controller.doc.source!==before.slice(0,selected.start)+value+before.slice(selected.end))throw Error(kind+' did not produce one exact transaction');t.check();t.controller.undo();if(t.controller.doc.source!==before)throw Error(kind+' undo failed');await t.settle();results.push({kind,oneChange:true,exact:t.check()});}return results

name: one-off-and-release-hold
pointer-drag-and-click
js: const t=editorTest;t.load('alpha\n\nbeta');let els=document.querySelectorAll('[data-block]');function rect(el,at){const p=reader.sourceModel.point(el,at),r=new Range();r.setStart(p.node,p.offset);r.setEnd(p.node,Math.min(p.node.length,p.offset+1));return r.getBoundingClientRect();}let a=rect(els[0],1),b=rect(els[1],2);const pointer=(el,type,r,buttons)=>el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type,{clientX:r.x+1,clientY:r.y+r.height/2,button:0,buttons,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));pointer(els[0],'pointerdown',a,1);if(document.querySelector('[data-role=block-editor]'))throw Error('Opened on pointer down');pointer(els[0],'pointerup',a,0);els[0].dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{clientX:a.x+1,clientY:a.y+a.height/2,bubbles:true}));if(!document.querySelector('[data-role=block-editor]'))throw Error('Click did not open');els=document.querySelectorAll('[data-block]');a=rect(els[0],1);b=rect(els[1],2);pointer(els[0],'pointerdown',a,1);pointer(els[1],'pointermove',b,1);pointer(els[1],'pointerup',b,0);const selected=t.editor.selection();if(document.querySelector('[data-role=block-editor]')||!selected||selected.start>=selected.end)throw Error('Drag did not preserve rendered selection');return {openedOnlyAfterRelease:true,dragClosed:true,selection:selected,exact:t.check()}
